stemMd: A hospital recorded more minor infections after introducing a new monitoring system, although independent checks found no deterioration in hygiene. Which fact best explains the rise?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The hospital serves meals to patients.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The new system detects mild infections that previously went unrecorded.

explanationMd: Separate the underlying infection rate from the recorded rate. Improved detection can raise reported cases without any increase in actual infections or deterioration in hygiene.

distractorRationale.a: Meal service does not explain changed detection.
distractorRationale.b: Equipment size does not establish the sensitivity of reporting.
distractorRationale.c: Stationery has no stated relation to infection detection.
distractorRationale.d: Room preference does not explain the record change.
